description:
The Acme Corp website is suffering from poor performance scores. A performance audit indicated that static assets are not being cached by browsers.

Your task is to enable and configure browser caching for the 'acmecorp.test' virtual server using Virtualmin.

Specifically:
1. Ensure the Apache 'expires' module (mod_expires) is enabled globally.
2. Configure the 'acmecorp.test' virtual server to set a default expiration policy of 1 month (30 days).
   - You should use the 'ExpiresDefault' directive.
   - Set the period to '1 month' (or '30 days').

You can verify your work by checking the HTTP headers of the test file at http://acmecorp.test/cache_test.css.
